requiredConfiguration.why: the native SDK 0.2.1rc2 adapter always calls the Anthropic Messages API and omits thinking.budget_tokens, which OpenRouter rejects; the patch swaps in the openai-completions adapter

diagnostics: direct POST to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/messages with a minimal Anthropic body returned 200 (endpoint is supported)
the runtime's unpatched body was rejected 400 Invalid Anthropic Messages API request
removing thinking -> 200; adding thinking.budget_tokens -> 200; so the runtime's thinking object was the invalid part
installing the openai-completions transport patch (deploy/patches/openrouter.patch.yml) plus DSH_MODEL made the engine complete with a real file side effect

notCovered: container-isolated tool-using run against a remote provider
